shared_or_similar_visual_information: The direction of a marked trace on a number line or function graph. Compare the arrow on the blue graph trace in the left image with the raised trace attached to the number-line mark at 3 in the right image.
mathematical_meanings: Left image: The depicted graph continues toward inputs smaller than the right endpoint x = 1. Right image: The marked ray admits values smaller than 3.
Rationales: The selected cue in each image selects values on the smaller-input side of the boundary. This gives the same local constraint rule in the two contexts.
